item.title: Tree dangerously large, 28th August
item.description:
I’ve contacted you on several occasions, most recently in May 2025 but actually dating back to 2022 regarding the lime tree at the entrance to Linden Close bordering our property at 35 Linden Avenue. Given our increasingly wet and windy winters and warnings of significantly worse to come, I genuinely fear for the safety of our property given the tree’s proximity to our house and garden and the alarming height and breadth it has now reached. More than twice the height of our house. I’ve hitherto failed to succeed in having action taken (even though the mirror image tree across the road was taken down last year due to damage it was causing) but surely as a minimum the tree can and should be reduced in size. As the accompanying photo illustrates, the tree is within a disturbingly close distance of our house if large branches or indeed the tree itself were to fall. Indeed we already regularly experience sizeable branches landing in our garden, some actually hitting our kitchen windows. Please treat this request seriously and I await your reply. Thank you

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 1, Linden Close, Lynworth, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
